manifest_hash_binding.rule: The final PR exact head binds the manifest Git blob; manifest files[].sha256 binds every non-manifest package path. The manifest omits its own SHA-256 to avoid a circular self-hash.

summary_en: All 167/167 paths in the current exact submission package have contributor decisions for authorship/source, licence, attribution, transformation, redistribution and exceptions, bound through final PR exact head -> manifest Git blob -> SHA-256 for 166 non-manifest paths. The package may be reviewed, displayed and redistributed under component-specific terms; no single package-wide licence exists. Four new photorealistic scenes are explicitly disclosed as model-generated synthetic G0 concepts with method and non-evidence boundaries. Independent legal advice, independent file-level legal audit and trademark review remain absent.
